title: Completeness and canonical unit on constructible ordinary tensor
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E/Q_ell, and let W be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme whose residue fields invert ell. For two constructible integral complexes M,N [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], form their actual ordinary derived tensor from lem-fix-constructible-tensor-completion-presentation. This tensor is derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete], and its canonical completion unit is invertible. No completed-tensor comparison or coordinate normalization is asserted here.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.5, pp. 49–50 (the ordinary derived tensor of constructible complexes is already complete), with Definition 6.5.1 and Lemmas 6.5.3–6.5.4, p. 49; Definition 3.4.10 and Lemma 3.4.12(4), pp. 22–23 (completed tensor and canonical reduction-tower completion). Specialization R=O_E; its residue ring is a field, so the constructibility convention agrees with def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed.

proof.text: Put $H=M\otimes^L_BN$ and use the canonical completion $C_W$ and unit $\eta_H$ of lem-fix-qcqs-completion-unit-locality. Apply lem-fix-constructible-projective-chart-refinement to $M,N$: it gives a finite qcqs open–closed tree and, on a pro-etale cover of every leaf, bounded representatives $P_i,Q_i$ with finite-projective sheaf terms. The covers and both representatives are simultaneous, so no compatibility of separately chosen models is assumed.

source.place: Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion; Tag 09BL, lemma-closed-immersion-affines-apply; Tag 09BM, lemma-closed-immersion-complement-retrocompact-exact. Agent formulation of canonical-unit locality on qcqs schemes from returned item steps 1, 2 and 7; Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.5.8 and Remark 6.5.10.

proof.text: On each simultaneous chart, apply lem-fix-projective-tensor-chart-complete to the two bounded finite-projective representatives. It identifies ordinary pullback of the canonical ordinary tensor with the tensor of those representatives, and proves its Roos-triangle completeness. The finite chart composites give a pro-etale covering family because their point images cover the leaf and the finitely many chart domains are quasi-compact.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.5, pp. 49–50, finite-projective devissage; Definition 3.4.10 and Proposition 3.5.1. Explicit completed-ring-sheaf version of returned item steps 5 and 6. Also Stacks proetale.tex Tag 099M, lemma-naive-completion, and sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok.

proof.text: Apply the finite-tree detection clause of lem-fix-qcqs-completion-unit-locality to $H$ and these covers. It gives that $\eta_H$ is invertible on $W$ and that $H$ is derived complete in the stated Roos-triangle sense. This also treats an empty root, since its chart conditions are vacuous.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorComplete_onConstructible
    [CompactSpace W] [QuasiSeparatedSpace W]
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (M N : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E W))
    (hM : sfIntegralConstructible l E W M) (hN : sfIntegralConstructible l E W N) :
    IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted l E W ((ordinaryTensor l E W).obj (M, N)) ∧
      IsIso ((tensorCompletionUnit l E W).app ((ordinaryTensor l E W).obj (M, N)))
